definitions.explanation: The person or entity that hires and pays workers. Often used in legal or formal contexts, and also in everyday speech to refer to one's boss or the person who hired you.

examples.japanese: {雇|やと}い{主|ぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。

{雇|やと}い{主|ぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明示|めいじ}→明示：13031_meiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Employers have an obligation to clearly state the working conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雇|やと}い{主|ぬし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{推薦状|すいせんじょう}→推薦状：15195_suisenjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please prepare a letter of recommendation from your previous employer.

notes:
A compound of {雇|やと}い (hiring, from ⟦{雇|やと}う→雇う：02320_yatou⟧ 'to hire') and ⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (master, owner).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雇用主|こようぬし} is more formal and used in legal/official documents
- ⟦{使用者|しようしゃ}→使用者：29863_shiyousha⟧ is the legal term for employer in labor law
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ means company president, not employer in general

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雇|やと}い{主|ぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (employer's responsibility)
- {雇|やと}い{主|ぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧ (employer and employees)
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雇|やと}い{主|ぬし} (former employer)
